description: Flooded area within the administrative region for a return-period event
aggregation_method: Sum of geographic cell areas where flood depth is positive within the administrative region
source_notes: JRC river-flood depth rasters for RP10, RP20, RP50, RP75, RP100, RP200, and RP500; no-data is treated as dry

description: Administrative-region area flooded during a return-period event
aggregation_method: Flooded cell area divided by administrative-region area and multiplied by 100
source_notes: JRC river-flood depth rasters for RP10 through RP500

description: Area-weighted mean flood depth across flooded cells for a return-period event
aggregation_method: Area-weighted arithmetic mean of positive flood depths within the administrative region; zero where no cells are flooded
source_notes: JRC river-flood depth rasters for RP10 through RP500; raster values are treated as metres

description: Area-weighted 90th-percentile flood depth across flooded cells for a return-period event
aggregation_method: Weighted empirical 90th percentile of positive flood depths using geographic cell area as weight; zero where no cells are flooded
source_notes: JRC river-flood depth rasters for RP10 through RP500; raster values are treated as metres

description: Slope vegetation opportunity area in other land cover within the administrative region

description: Slope vegetation opportunity area in cropland within the administrative region

description: Total mangrove restoration opportunity area assigned to the administrative region
aggregation_method: Count of classes 1 to 3 multiplied by the nominal cell area; cells outside polygons are assigned to the nearest region within 5 km
source_notes: Global mangrove restoration opportunity raster (ManRestorClass_9s.tif)

description: Mangrove restoration opportunity area on accreting shorelines assigned to the administrative region
aggregation_method: Count of class 1 cells multiplied by the nominal cell area with the 5 km nearest-region rule
source_notes: Global mangrove restoration opportunity raster (ManRestorClass_9s.tif)

description: Mangrove restoration opportunity area on static or moderately retreating shorelines assigned to the administrative region
aggregation_method: Count of class 2 cells multiplied by the nominal cell area with the 5 km nearest-region rule
source_notes: Global mangrove restoration opportunity raster (ManRestorClass_9s.tif)

description: Mangrove restoration opportunity area on fast-retreating shorelines assigned to the administrative region
aggregation_method: Count of class 3 cells multiplied by the nominal cell area with the 5 km nearest-region rule
source_notes: Global mangrove restoration opportunity raster (ManRestorClass_9s.tif)

description: River catchment restoration opportunity area within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Count of binary opportunity cells equal to 1 multiplied by the nominal 0.0625 square kilometres per cell
source_notes: Global non-coastal tree NbS opportunity raster (G_PotentialNonCoastalTreeNBS_9s.tif)

description: Total planting cost for an NbS class within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Sum of valid planting cost per hectare over assigned opportunity cells multiplied by the nominal 6.25 hectares per cell
source_notes: Generic planting costs for slope vegetation and river catchment restoration; mangrove-specific planting costs for mangroves

description: Total natural-regeneration cost for an NbS class within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Sum of valid regeneration cost per hectare over assigned opportunity cells multiplied by the nominal 6.25 hectares per cell
source_notes: Generic regeneration costs for slope vegetation and river catchment restoration; mangrove-specific regeneration costs for mangroves

description: Total potential carbon benefit for an NbS class within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Sum of valid carbon benefit per hectare over assigned opportunity cells multiplied by the nominal 6.25 hectares per cell
source_notes: Global 50-year carbon benefit raster (G_CarbonBenefit_9s.tif), applied to all three NbS classes

description: Mean potential biodiversity benefit for an NbS class within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Arithmetic mean of valid biodiversity values over assigned opportunity cells
source_notes: Global biodiversity benefit raster (G_BioBenefit_9s.tif), applied to all three NbS classes

description: Total planting cost for a slope-vegetation land-cover or mangrove shoreline-condition category within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Sum of valid planting cost per hectare over assigned opportunity cells in the encoded category multiplied by the nominal 6.25 hectares per cell; category totals reconcile to the NbS-class total
source_notes: Opportunity classes from the global slope vegetation or mangrove restoration raster combined with the corresponding planting-cost raster

description: Total natural-regeneration cost for a slope-vegetation land-cover or mangrove shoreline-condition category within the administrative region
aggregation_method: Sum of valid regeneration cost per hectare over assigned opportunity cells in the encoded category multiplied by the nominal 6.25 hectares per cell; category totals reconcile to the NbS-class total

description: Total potential carbon benefit for a slope-vegetation land-cover or mangrove shoreline-condition category within the administrative region

description: Mean potential biodiversity benefit for a slope-vegetation land-cover or mangrove shoreline-condition category within the administrative region

source_notes: Opportunity classes from the global slope vegetation or mangrove restoration raster combined with G_BioBenefit_9s.tif
